text:
Anya Patel: Hey folks — I'm in Seattle next week (Capitol Hill) and need a quick dinner rec. Prefer casual + good vegetarian options. Landing Fri evening, would like something open late. Any favorites?
Derek Kim: Uneeda Burger is a safe pick, solid veggie burger and quick service, about a 10 min walk from the office.
Sam H: If you're leaning vegan/healthier, 'Plum Vegan' on 15th has great bowls and beers, cozy spot.
Leah Gomez: For slightly nicer but still casual, Terra does seasonal veg plates — might need a reservation on Fri.
Ryan O'Neill: TacoLoco is late-night and solid for grilled veggie tacos, cheap and fast.
Anya Patel: Helpful — anyone know Fri hours? flight gets in around 6:15pm so looking for places open past 7:30/8.
Derek Kim: Uneeda usually open til midnight on Fridays. Plum Vegan closes around 10. Terra typically closes 9:30.
Sam H: TacoLoco is open til ~11:30 on Fri, so good late option.
Leah Gomez: Quick poll to decide? Reply with an emoji: :zap: Uneeda, :herb: Plum Vegan, :taco: TacoLoco, :sparkles: Terra
Ryan O'Neill: :taco:
Sam H: :herb:
Derek Kim: :zap:
Anya Patel: Thanks y'all — leaning TacoLoco since it's late. Will DM if anyone wants to meet up after 8. :wave:
lunchbot: Poll closed — tally: Uneeda (1), Plum Vegan (1), TacoLoco (1), Terra (0).
Anya Patel: Cool, going to bookmark TacoLoco. Anyone got the address/link?
Ryan O'Neill: 404 15th Ave E — here's a quick map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/example-tacoloco (double-check on Google).
Anya Patel: Perfect, appreciate it!
